reviews.title: Stole my money. Beware!!
reviews.text:
App is ok overall, but beware of what you are signing up for. I originally subscribed through my iPhone, then later upgraded through my Mac. I didn't have time to use the app so cancelled the subscription. A few months later, I have been charged for the annual subscription again.

When I've queried why, they state that I had 2 subscriptions and cancelled one of them. Instead of realising their error, they refuse to refund me because it's more than 14 days from the ORIGINAL subscription. Question, would I have been charged 2 subscriptions if I hadn't cancelled one? If not then why are they reactivating the original subscription after I cancelled the upgraded one? Dodgy as hell. I will be raising this with my credit card company, apple and trading standards as this is a very underhand and illegal way to conduct business.

Shame really, I enjoyed the app itself and may have resubscribed when I had more time but after this experience, not a chance and I'd advise people to stay away from this app and any other from this company.

reviews.title: Interface fights you endlessly
reviews.text: Its editor on mobile will fight you endlessly, and I spend half of my time on each lesson just deleting and editing tags (especially closing ones) that it put in the wrong places. I would prefer typing everything out vs having to try to delete closing tags just to be forced to delete and reenter other things that didn’t need to be deleted. If you try to delete and re-add text to save time since the interface and editor fights you so hard, and you retyped the EXACT same text, such as “roar” the app will say that you got the lesson wrong until trumpets sound and kingdom come. Thirdly, if you try something, and it says you edits are wrong, and then you try something else, and tap on “see solution” the solution will be the EXACT same thing that you tried in the first place. So, I’m subtracting one star for the interface fighting the user, another star for not being able to retype text that you had to delete as a result of the uncooperative interface, and a third star for it telling you a solution is wrong when it was, in fact, correct.

reviews.title: Problems with syncing desktop to mobile app and terrible customer service. What am I paying for?!
reviews.text:
I am naming and shaming the agent Mercedesz, who ignored me when I tried to escalate after no solution was provided to my issue with how I completed the professional Python course and then one day my desktop projects disappeared as though I never did them. I am required to complete them again to get access to my certificate again but I thankfully saved the original link to it. 

No solution was provided after all the suggestions made. Mercedesz just said “Thanks for understanding” and ignored my follow-ups for over a week now and requests to escalate.

Don’t buy a Max plan—the customer service is a mess and because of syncing issues, some lessons I complete on the desktop aren’t showing on my mobile version, other times, I complete the mobile lesson and them it doesn’t register and I have to redo the lesson I just completed for a second time.

reviews.title: Lost its heart with the new keys feature unless paying for it
reviews.text:
I used to love this and recommend it to everyone,
however interested in learning  since the new ‘ keys’ feature replaces the hearts , it now locks you out on every mini piece of learning. This means that you cannot learn any good chunks, only tiny piece meal parts, 2 keys a day means two minor Learning points a day, it also mean you no longer care about getting it wrong as you did with hearts.

You now cannot use this to learn anything substantial in a short time without paying for the app now; which you can get free elsewhere.

This used to be a great way to learn, limited by mistakes (loosing hearts), this meant the leader board was also a possibility; again this is now really only for paying members. Which is clearly what they want as ads don’t make enough for them.

Such a shame! I plan to delete the app now and move on.

reviews.title: No follow through on promised refund.
reviews.text: I signed up for Mimo in February as a trial and they charged me for the whole year. I got in touch with Support and they said that they will switch my account to a monthly one and refund the balance after many many Support tickets. I officially canceled my subscription a couple of days later so should only have paid for one month. Not only after almost an entire year is the subscription not canceled but after multiple demands for them to delete my credit card information they my credit card. I have not logged into the service or been active on it and since February 2025 and I still cannot cancel my account. The only way to keep them from taking money monthly for me is to report them as fraudulent on my credit card. I could not recommend using the service because of their incredibly dishonest billing practices.
